# The subset's table: a re: line's pattern, less its re:, and the verdict every reader gives it. internal/denylist's
# TestSubset holds Go's reader to it, and internal/orchestrator's TestDenylistSubsetBash holds check/denylist.sh's.
# A line is "<verdict> <pattern>": take, subset (outside the subset, or one that does not compile) or empty (one that
# matches the empty string), then the pattern, the rest of the line as written, or Go-quoted when it starts with ".
# The subset's limits, 256 bytes and groups 32 deep, are in the tests' code. Lines starting with # and blank lines are
# skipped.

# Every construct the subset names.
take qx7
take q.7
take a\.b\*c\+d\?e\(f\)g\[h\]i\{j\}k\|l\^m\$n\\o
take a]b}c
take ^qx7$
take a^b
take (qx7|zorblax)
take ((q)(x7))
take [a-z]
take [^a-z0-9]
take [-a]
take [a-]
take [^-]
take [a-c-]
take [A-Z_.$*(]
take [a^]
take [&a&]
take [a:]
take [a:b]
take q?x7
take q*x7
take qx7+
take qx{2}
take qx{0,3}7
take qx{2,}7
take q{255}
take (q{10}){100}
take x(y|z)+w
take [ ]
take a b

# Escapes POSIX ERE does not define, and groups Go and Python read but grep does not.
subset \bqx7
subset \dqx7
subset q\x7
subset (q)\1
subset qx7\
subset (?i)qx7
subset (?:qx7)
subset (?=q)x7

# Groups and branches.
subset (qx7
subset qx7)
subset )
subset ()
subset (|qx7)
subset qx7|
subset |qx7

# Quantifiers: at a branch's start, after another, after an anchor, and counts.
subset *qx7
subset +
subset qx7**
subset qx7*?
subset qx7+?
subset qx7?+
subset q{2}{3}
subset ^*q
subset q$?
subset q{,2}
subset q{
subset q{2
subset q{02}
subset q{3,2}
subset q{256}
subset q{1,256}
subset {2}
subset ((q{10}){10}){11}

# Classes: ] first, empty, unclosed, a backslash or [ inside, ranges out of kind or order, doubled & ~ |, and : first,
# which GNU grep refuses as a misspelt [[:ab:]].
subset []a]
subset []
subset [^]
subset [a
subset [\.]
subset [[:alpha:]]
subset [a[]
subset [z-a]
subset [a-Z]
subset [0-z]
subset [!-/]
subset [a-c-e]
subset [a--]
subset [a&&b]
subset [a||b]
subset [a~~b]
subset [:a:]
subset [^:ab:]
subset x[:zq:]
subset [:a]

# Bytes outside printable ASCII.
subset "\xc3\xa9tang"
subset "q\tx7"
subset "q\x7fx7"

# Lines that match the empty string, which every line holds.
empty ""
empty ^
empty $
empty ^$
empty q*
empty (qx7)?
empty q{0}
empty (q|x*)
empty [a-z]*
